en: Does your hair stick to your knit? 3 outfit fixes for static
01 Swap acrylic knits for cotton — synthetics build up more static
02 Skirt clinging? A little lotion on your legs or tights helps
03 Pull a cotton shirt collar out over your knit at the neckline
Sources: Science Times, Samsung Newsroom, Allure Korea, News1

en: Skip the long coat — it's all about this one length
Her: cropped cream tweed jacket, charcoal shift dress, mustard scarf, ankle boots
Him: short green duffle coat, Nordic ski sweater, flannel wide pants, derbies
Formula: short on top, long below, one pop of color near the neck
Save it for tomorrow's commute. Sources: Vogue Korea, News1
